cookies.name: fcr_session
cookies.purpose: Maintain the allowlisted founder's Supabase Auth browser session and provide a server-issued interactive founder-session witness for privileged merge authority.
cookies.integrity: HMAC-SHA256 signed by Founder Control Room; unsigned or tampered payloads are rejected.
cookies.csrf: Exact FOUNDER_API_URL origin is required for browser mutations; explicit Bearer clients are not cookie-authenticated.
cookies.deletion: Cleared by POST /auth/logout and by failed or disallowed session verification. Existing unsigned cookies are intentionally invalid after the signed-session contract is enabled.

prohibited: unsigned or client-forgeable founder session cookies
caching any response that writes or refreshes the founder session
